```{r}
setwd("D:/计量方法在翻译研究中的应用2026/Lecture 2")
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

corpus <- read.csv("sttr_results.csv")
```

```{r}
attach(corpus)
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
hist(STTR[TextType=='EO'],main='',xlab='EO')

hist(STTR[TextType=='HT'],main='',xlab='HT')
```
```{r}
shapiro.test(STTR[TextType=='EO'])
```

```{r}
shapiro.test(STTR[TextType=='HT'])
```

```{r}
wilcox.test(STTR~TextType)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(corpus, aes(TextType, STTR, fill = TextType)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_continuous("STTR")+
  scale_x_discrete("corpus") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

```
